_meta.description: Sourced parameter ledger for the recycled aerospace Ti cases study. Every value carries a citation.

tdb.note: Reduced metallic reconstructions; O and N on interstitial sublattice (HCP_A3 0.5 sites, BCC_A2 3 sites). Provenance and SGTE references in each file header.
tdb.sha256: pinned per build in the run metadata block of each compute script

oxygen_equivalent_coeffs.source: Ogden, H.R., Jaffee, R.I., 1955. The effects of carbon, oxygen, and nitrogen on the mechanical properties of titanium and titanium alloys. Battelle TML Report 20. Coefficients derived from hardness data.

alternate_hardness_weighting.source: hardness effectiveness ratio N:O:C reported in interstitial strengthening literature (Conrad 1981)

acceptance_envelope_wt_pct._spec: ASTM B348 / AMS 4928 grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400)
acceptance_envelope_wt_pct.binding_constraint: composite O_eq, capped below the individual maxima
acceptance_envelope_wt_pct.source: ASTM B348; AMS 4928; embrittlement onset near 0.25 wt% O from Nayak et al. 2018 citing Donachie.

transus_anchors._description: Measured alpha/beta transus vs oxygen for Ti-6Al-4V, used as the constraint the computed surface must reproduce.
transus_anchors.sensitivity: 5 to 10 deg C per 0.03 wt% O
transus_anchors.empirical_transus_relation: beta transus rises 122 deg C per wt% O and 150 deg C per wt% N (multicomponent regression), giving an empirical N to O ratio near 1.2 to 1.3
transus_anchors.source: transus vs O bands from high cycle fatigue study of Ti-6Al-4V at varied oxygen (PMC7503640) and DiVA thesis 991369; empirical O and N coefficients compiled in Rojo Abecassis et al. 2018, J. Mater. Eng. Perform. 27, 4051 to 4061.

tramp_ceilings_wt_pct._description: Per element ceilings. Grade 5 names Fe; other residual elements follow the standard spec convention.
tramp_ceilings_wt_pct.note: Recycling accumulation may require tighter ceilings than the virgin spec; flagged for the qualification model.
tramp_ceilings_wt_pct.source: ASTM B348 grade 5 residual element limits; Fe as beta stabilizer, Min et al. 2021.

hydrogen._description: Tracked on its own axis; hydride pathway distinct from O_eq.
hydrogen.source: ASTM B348 grade 5; fcc delta hydride forms above ~200 ppm H in alpha Ti, Tal-Gutelmacher and Eliezer 2005; Nayak et al. 2018.

Ti-900.source: WAAM Ti-900 near alpha baseline; internal Odinzen branch; public analogs Ti-6242, IMI 834
